observation.visible_scene: A tabletop model scene on a green textured surface with a white backdrop: two light-wood train tracks meet at a junction, a small artificial evergreen tree stands to the right, and a vertical wall of stacked pale wooden blocks is built across the junction. A maroon toy locomotive sits on the left track.
visible_changes: At the start the maroon train is on the left track, partially visible, and progresses rightward toward the standing block wall; the wall remains upright and static through the early frames.
The train becomes hidden behind the wall for several frames while the wall still stands unchanged.
The wall then begins to bulge and topple forward (toward the camera and the right-hand track); its rows of blocks separate and fall.
As the blocks collapse, the maroon train reappears on the right side, moving rightward along the track and passing through the falling pile.
The train continues right and exits the frame; the blocks settle into a scattered, overlapping pile lying across the right track and foreground.
The tree, backdrop and ground remain fixed throughout, indicating little or no camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: The train's position and motion before the first frame, and the final resting arrangement of the blocks after the last frame.
Whether the train physically contacted and pushed the wall, or the wall collapsed independently as the train passed.
uncertain_details: The exact moment of contact between train and wall is not directly visible because the wall occludes the train during the transition.
Small residual camera jitter cannot be ruled out, but the static background suggests the viewpoint is essentially fixed.
